name: drift_same_for_both_sides
description: Undertow's Drift (design 1.4, contract-m7 §2) is one offer for both sides: two clients of one duel, both seats played by their plans and pressing Ready, see the same EV_DRIFT for windows 2 to 6 (three packs each, the fourth left out), once per window and never per hollow, and the same packs for the open window from SimMatch's query of them (the contract's); the shared clock sounds every horn on both hollows on one tick and opens each window for both together, and in window 6 both seats cork the same offered pack. Their hashes agree throughout.

steps.assert: drift1 == drift2 and drift1.size() == 5 and scene.rows('DRIFT', ['window']) == [[2], [3], [4], [5], [6]]
steps.msg: both clients drew the same packs for windows 2 to 6, once a window

steps.assert: drift1[4][1].size() == 3 and not drift1[4][1].has(drift1[4][2]) and m.drift_offer() == drift1[4][1] and scene.client(2).drift_offer() == m.drift_offer()
steps.msg: each offer is three packs without the one left out, and drift_offer() gives the open window's on both

steps.assert: scene.rows('WAVE', ['tick', 'wave'], {'start': true, 'hollow': 0}) == scene.rows('WAVE', ['tick', 'wave'], {'start': true, 'hollow': 1}) and scene.rows('WAVE', ['tick'], {'start': true, 'hollow': 0}).size() == 5
steps.msg: every horn sounded on both hollows on the same tick

steps.assert: m.hollows[0].phase == 0 and m.hollows[1].phase == 0 and m.hollows[0].countdown_t == m.hollows[1].countdown_t
steps.msg: the window is open for both with one countdown
both seats corked the same pack of the one offer, at the window's tier and price
